devices.title: Oracle Server X7-2c
facts: Name of Product; Product Description; Date; Dependent Products; dated accessibility conformance report, not installation/service manual
Official Oracle public documentation fetched 2026-10-04 is byte-identical to previously saved capture; prior request URL/time remain historically unknown.
SM 1U and SM 2U descriptions retained as separate variant sections. Neither establishes the owned unit variant or installed configuration. No alias, OEM/manufacturer or deployment inference.
150W Max and 205W Max / 165W Max for GPU are printed in processor descriptions; not PSU ratings, AC input requirements or measured wall draw.
